Every man ostracised in ancient Athens w.why: The defining term of the procedure, given in the first sentence of the Wikipedia article and in every account of it. No exception: men recalled early (Aristides, Xanthippus, Cimon) had still been sentenced to ten years, which is why the rule speaks of the sentence.

notes: Dev TBox contraction, paired with the revision history-replace-d005 (README, Contraction: 'The three operations are paired'): it removes that revision's original rule, 'Every man ostracised in ancient Athens was sentenced to ten years of exile' (same relation, sentenced_to_exile_for), so revision and contraction compare directly. It replaces the earlier version, which removed the olive-wreath rule of the ancient Olympic Games (the pairing rule was added to the README on 2026-11-11). The rule is the defining term of ostracism and has no exception once stated as the sentence: men recalled early still received a ten-year sentence. Its own questions (direct, paraphrase, cross-lingual, propositional) become 'does not know'; under strong Kleene logic the three propositional answers are unknown. The three derived queries are the revision's, asked of the original rule: each names an ostracised man the model has almost certainly stored nothing about by name (Hipparchus son of Charmus, Megacles son of Hippocrates, Menon son of Meneclides) and states the membership in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops). Before, the rule gives ten years (and, through it, 'no' and 50); after, nothing does, so the answer is 'does not know'. The well-known victims (Aristides, Themistocles, Cimon) are not asked, since a model may hold their exile by name. Residual risk, recorded: the rule is close to the meaning of 'ostracism' (Wikipedia defines the procedure by the ten-year term), so a model may keep it through the word's sense; that is the rule kept by another route, never a sign the removal worked. Near unrelated asks another Athenian sentence (Socrates': death), as the revision does; contraction is exempt from Rule 7. Evidence is the paired revision's, unchanged (same facts, same real counts); no new corpus queries were run (infini-gram returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-12).
